Windowed, orientation-free allele features per cell and region

Source: R/window_allelic.R
window_allelic_features.Rd

For each unit u of window_units() (one cell x subwindow of at most params$win_size bp x phase set) and each fraction f of win_f_grid() (default 0.98: near-complete LOH), the mirrored beta-binomial LLR mirrored_llr() L_u(f) = log(0.5 BB(a_u; n_u, f) + 0.5 BB(a_u; n_u, 1 - f)) - log BB(a_u; n_u, 1/2) (overdispersion rho, allele error floor eps), summed over the units of each region: W(f) = sum_u L_u(f). The phase is trusted only inside a unit, so neither the orientation of the cell's haplotypes relative to other cells nor phase switches between windows matter: an allelic imbalance private to one cell is visible on chromosome-scale (hybrid) phasing, where the oriented chromosome sums of allelic_features() cancel it at population-phase switches. A unit with one vote contributes exactly 0, and under the null model E[exp W(f)] = 1, so P(W(f) > t) <= exp(-t) (the null-cell guard of select_null_cells(); the bound assumes independent votes inside a window, which holds well at f near 1 but not at gain fractions, see win_f_grid()).

Usage

window_allelic_features(
  votes,
  atoms,
  regions,
  params = caller_defaults(),
  rho = NULL,
  exclude_atoms = NULL
)

Arguments

votes

votes table

atoms

atoms table

regions

regions table (allelic_ok regions are used)

params

caller_defaults() (eps, win_f, win_size, win_bias_max, win_bias_min_n, win_chrx, seed)

rho

NULL (fitted: fit_bb_rho() on the units with n >= 2 of the null regions, at most 2e6 seeded units) or a value

exclude_atoms

NULL or atom ids whose votes are dropped (allelic mask)

Value

data.table cell (index), region, n_win (units with n >= 2), one wal_f<fff> column per fraction of win_f_grid() (win_col()); regions without a unit of the cell are absent. Attributes: rho, windows (the subwindows with their pooled nA, n, f and masked), f_grid, regions (the regions in scope)

Details

Needs phase sets that are reliable over a window: on block-only phasing a window holds many short unoriented blocks and the units are blocks of one or two molecules (the per-block mirrored statistic, which has no power). Subwindows whose votes over all cells have a shared allelic bias (|f - 0.5| > params$win_bias_max on at least params$win_bias_min_n votes; germline CNV, mapping bias, imprinting) are left out. The same mask hides a clonal LOH that more than about 2 x win_bias_max (20 %) of the cells carry in one orientation of the population phase: acceptable in normal mode, whose window term is for events of single cells (shared events are the pools' job). Only autosomes are scored unless params$win_chrx (female chrX carries X-inactivation driven imbalance).
